run_lora_a_embedding: run LoRA A embedding lookup with CUDA graph support on input tokens and weights
run_lora_a_sgemm: run segment GEMM of LoRA A modules on input matrix and LoRA weights
run_lora_b_sgemm: run segment GEMM of LoRA B modules on input matrix and LoRA weights
run_qkv_lora: run the LoRA pass for QKV projection layer with input matrix and LoRA weights
init_cuda_graph_moe_buffers: initialize CUDA graph MoE intermediate buffers for LoRA with given batch size and ranks
